title: Existence of Time-Dependent Bivariational Quantum Dynamics
exact_target: Under what mathematical hypotheses does time-dependent bivariational quantum approximation produce an actual trajectory?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002892 (OWR-13684-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Methods in Quantum Molecular Dynamics (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/27, pp. 1499--1569. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 61, 62, 63.

status_qualification: The action explains the bivariational convention, not an asserted globally well-posed system for arbitrary trial spaces. The question asks existence and conditions, and does not already assume a nondegenerate finite-dimensional manifold.
